open_points.subject: A03 sandbox network namespace and startup qualification
open_points.text: “own loopback — up, as bubblewrap leaves it in a new network namespace” is required, while “the kernel does not inspect or verify [it] at run time” and the start check “asks only that a probe execution succeeds”; no supported bubblewrap version or response when bubblewrap leaves a different interface state is specified
open_points.question: What must happen when the installed bubblewrap can execute the probe but does not leave exactly one up loopback interface with no external reachability?
options: explicitly configure the namespace to the required state
start and rely on the installed bubblewrap behavior
open_points.default_guess: refuse kernel startup unless the installed bubblewrap is a release-qualified version known to provide the required namespace state
